title: Passage and Horizon
author: Ansel Sterling
blurb: Sebastian Villalobos, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
